name: Ak-Sai Canyons
near: The village of Ak-Sai on the south shore of Issyk-Kul, ≈16 km west of Bokonbaevo; the canyons begin 5 km from the Balykchy–Karakol highway (or from the village itself) and stretch toward the lake, ending ≈1 km from the shore.
elev: ≈1750 m (average height of the canyons per smapse/LJ 2024); a range of ≈1650 m near the lake to ≈1900 m in the foothills (estimated from the lake level of 1607 m).
short: A system of dry erosion channels and light sandstone canyons between the village of Ak-Sai and the south shore of Issyk-Kul, covering more than 15 km². The “Valley of Forgotten Rivers” bears traces of streams that fill only in snowy springs. A wild, empty place with a view of the lake from the ridges; access by gravel road/channels in an SUV.
desc: The Ak-Sai canyons lie on the south shore of Issyk-Kul, 200 km from Bishkek and 130 km from Karakol, 16 km from Bokonbaevo. This is not one canyon but a network of branching channels in layered deposits — red, yellow, orange and white — carved by spring floods that have become rarer in recent years: hence the local name “Valley of Forgotten Rivers”. The main channel, about 11 km long, runs from the highway to the lake and ends a kilometer from the water; the track runs along it too — sand and gravel with many dry side channels, impassable after rain. From the ridges there are panoramas of the lake and Terskey Ala-Too; there are no marked trails, but there is a short route, “Ak-Sai Panorama”, of ≈2 km with an 80 m ascent. There is no infrastructure — no shade, water or shops; the nearest place to stay is the Remote. Forgotten Rivers lodge (the Ak-Sai Travel team) next to the canyons, and guesthouses and yurts in Bokonbaevo. The landscapes have been filmed for series and movies as an “alien planet”. Names like “Sun Peak”, “Bridge Through Time” and “Ancient Trail” from old descriptions are not confirmed on the map.
guide: Come here for the silence: unlike Skazka, there are no buses and no barrier with a cashier, only wind and the rustle of sand under the wheels. The main channel is like a road in a movie: 11 km between white walls, where the car drives right along the bed of a dried-up river, so take an SUV and watch the sky over the mountains — a downpour in Terskey turns the channel into a torrent. Climb any ridge — the blue strip of Issyk-Kul against the sun-bleached canyons is exactly that “Martian” shot. The best light is in the evening: the white and yellow layers glow orange, while by day the landscape fades. Combine it with Salt Lake Tuz-Kol 13 km away — after the dust of the canyons, floating on the water as in the Dead Sea feels especially good.
see: The main dry channel (≈11 km) with white and red walls; branching side canyons; layered colored deposits; ridges with a panorama of Issyk-Kul; the “Ak-Sai Panorama” route (2 km, +80 m); sunset over the lake; the neighboring salt lake Tuz-Kol (13 km).
skip: If you have an ordinary passenger car and it has rained — the channels turn soft, and there is no tow truck here. If you have already been to Skazka and the “Mars” canyons and expect brighter colors — Ak-Sai is paler, its strength lies in scale and solitude. If you don't have 4–5 hours for the road from Bishkek one way.
diff: Easy for a walk along the channel and ridges (1–3 h, ascent up to 100 m), but with no trails or shade; moderate for the driver: 5–13 km of gravel and sandy channels, an SUV at minimum, 4×4 is better.
when: May to October; spring and autumn are optimal (mild temperatures after the dry period); in summer only morning/evening. Don't go after rain or during snowmelt (soft clay, mudflows). In winter — ice and sticky clay.
hours: Open around the clock, a free territory without fences or ticket booths (Trip.com 2026: “24/7”).
daytime: Evening 1–2 hours before sunset — warm light on the light-colored layers and a sunset over the lake; morning — for coolness. Midday — faded colors and heat.
how: From Bishkek along the highway through Balykchy and the south shore to the village of Ak-Sai (≈200 km, 4–5 h), turn off the highway to the south/toward the canyons; then 5–13 km of gravel and channels. From Karakol ≈130 km (1.5–2 h to the turnoff). Without a car: a marshrutka (minibus) Bishkek → Bokonbaevo or Ak-Sai, then a local taxi (Trip.com 2026). Navigation is unreliable — use an offline map and the “Ak-Sai Canyons” point in Google Maps; agree on the turnoff with the lodge/driver.
needcar: Yes: an SUV at minimum, 4×4 recommended (I Love KG); according to a 2026 review an ordinary car can manage 5–7 km of dry dirt road, but not the channels after rain. On foot 5 km from the highway is possible, but without shade and water.
self: Yes, if you have an SUV, an offline map and dry weather; there are no trails or signs — navigate by the channels and ridges, and tell someone your route (I Love KG).
roadtype: The Bishkek–Balykchy–south shore highway is paved road of excellent quality; from the highway/village there are 5–13 km of gravel and sandy dry channels (“heavy gravel”, I Love KG; “the last 5–7 km is dirt road”, Trip.com 2026). Impassable after rain, dangerous in a thunderstorm.
traveltime: From Bishkek 4–5 h to the village of Ak-Sai; from Karakol 1.5–2 h; from Bokonbaevo ≈30 min; along the channel to the viewpoints 20–40 min in a 4×4. A visit takes 1–3 h.
stay: Remote. Forgotten Rivers is a lodge by the canyons from the Ak-Sai Travel team (booking.com; prices on request, not confirmed); Bokonbaevo: CBT guesthouses, Bel-Tam Yurt Camp on the shore, private rooms; yurt camps on the south shore (Tosor, Kaji-Sai). A 2024 benchmark for south-shore prices — from 1600 ₽ (RUB)/person in yurt camps.
net: There is a signal in the village of Ak-Sai and in Bokonbaevo (Beeline strengthened Bokonbaevo in 04.2026, economist.kg); in the canyon channels reception is unstable — I Love KG advises saving an offline map and telling someone your route. There are no operator measurements.
entry: Sources conflict: Trip.com (May, no year) — “entry is free”; the 2026 Trip.com guide — “eco fee 50–100 som, parking free”; Putevye istorii 2022, smapse 2024, Kabar 2024 do not mention fees; Sputnik8 includes “all fees” in its tour. Not confirmed: the current fee and who collects it. Most likely free or an irregular local fee.
transfer: From Bishkek: a taxi/transfer 6000–10,000 som round trip, a group tour 1500–3500 som/person (Trip.com 2026); Sputnik8 excursions $330 / Tripster €345 per car (2026). A local taxi from Bokonbaevo — price not confirmed (south-shore benchmark 2024: 1500 som per car with a wait to Skazka).
bring: 2 L of water per person, closed shoes, a hat, sunscreen, a windbreaker, cash in som, an offline map/GPS, a first-aid kit, a reserve of fuel (fuel stations in Balykchy and Bokonbaevo), and for a 4×4 — a shovel and tow rope.
warn: Dry channels turn into mudflows when it rains in the mountains — don't enter or park in narrow canyons in a thunderstorm. The walls are unstable — don't stand under overhangs. There is no shade, water, signal or help; navigators lead the wrong way — agree on the turnoff with locals. “Sun Peak” and “Bridge Through Time” from old descriptions are unconfirmed landmarks. Soft clay in winter and spring bogs down even SUVs.
food: There is nothing in the canyons. The nearest food is the cafes and canteens of Bokonbaevo (lagman, manty, Issyk-Kul fish), home-cooked lunches in CBT guesthouses; at the Remote. Forgotten Rivers lodge — meals for guests (not confirmed). Bring food and water with you.
reviews: Google Maps: there is no separate listing with a rating in the data export (ambiguous result). Reports 2022–2026 (Putevye istorii, smapse/LJ, Trip.com, Tripster 4.9 for the tour organizer): pros — solitude, “Martian” scale, views of the lake, sunsets; cons — a hard road, no infrastructure or signs, paler in color than Skazka.
p.sum: The canyons lie by the village of Ak-Sai on the south shore, ≈16 km west of Bokonbaevo: from the highway, following signs, 5–13 km of gravel and sandy dry channels to a spot at the edge of the canyons, then 30 minutes on foot to the panorama (the “Ak Sai Panorama” route ≈2 km, +80 m). You need a car with ground clearance, preferably a 4×4 (let air out of the tires in sand); don't go during or after rain. Without your own car — a taxi from Bokonbaevo through CBT or a tour from Bishkek ($330 / €345 per car for 10 h). It is convenient to stay in Bokonbaevo or on the beach at Ton (Bel-Tam, from $17–23).
